[[File:A-wings_bogden.jpg|thumb|250px|The marooned freighter used as a base by Ren-Cha]]
A '''freighter''' marooned on the [[bog moon of Bogden]] was used as a makeshift [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] at some point in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. Ren-Cha and his [[Pirates of Tarnoonga]] used it as a temporary base when they kidnapped [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Gerin Toda|Gerin]], the daughter of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Malameu Toda]], warrior-chieftain of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an's]] [[Outer Territories]]. Toda later raided the base with the help of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mon Julpa]] and a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of soldiers.
